name: EPIC 250147158

text.card: A red giant 2,823 parsecs away, 11 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 15, give 1.03 solar masses and 11.1 solar radii; GALAH spectra give 5,117 K at its surface.
